changes: TEST pixel-office-docs.test.js FS-16 (lines about 126-185): the three regexes are now two named constants OLD_FACTS and OLD_STATE. OLD_FACTS keeps the Russian forms (задач n/, полоса хода, «завершена») and adds the English forms of the same three facts: tasks? n/, progress bar|strip, move strip, «completed». The English 'progress bar|strip' counts only when it is not denied (not right after 'no ', 'without ', 'without a '), because the real README says 'There is no progress bar and no task counter' - a denial is not the removed feature. The limits check uses OLD_STATE («завершена» or «completed»). The invented 'old' sample is kept and 7 English sample lines are added, each shown to fire the guard on its own, plus 2 denial lines that must give 0. Criterion: REQ-036/045/044 README criterion that the section must not describe the removed counter, strip and state (FS-16 title), decisions/0080 item 6 (a test is never weakened, only re-pointed at the same fact).

issues.text: Dependency on DOC-UPDATER: tools/test/traces-readme.test.js TD-3 (line 50) now expects 'git clone <Sai repository address>' as in README.md line 231 (gate finding L2). If DOC-UPDATER restores the Russian placeholder, TD-3 turns red and the one line must go back.

Limit of the FS-16 guard: the English 'progress bar/strip' is accepted when it follows 'no ', 'without ' or 'without a ' (the README says 'There is no progress bar and no task counter'). A sentence that denies it in another way ('does not have a progress bar') would turn the test red - a loud, not a silent, failure - and the regex would then be widened by the next fixer.

The same kind of risk exists in tests of the Pixel Office page and panels (pixel-office-page.test.js, pixel-office-panels.test.js): negative checks on Russian UI words. They read the page, whose texts stay Russian by decisions/0080 item 3, so they are not affected by the translation; not changed.
